confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or price pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; July accommodation rates vary widely, so hotel and hostel anchors are least certain. Cocktail and wine_glass use the local beer relationship (cocktail about twice draft beer; wine glass slightly above beer) because direct knowledge is weak. Local-currency examples were converted at approximate general-knowledge rates. The FX value came from search-result text for the RBA exchange-rates page, not from an opened rate table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Georgia is transcontinental and is grouped under Europe here because Tbilisi price levels track Eastern and Southeastern European capitals such as Sofia or Belgrade; Yerevan is a regional cross-check for restaurant and drink prices.

anchor_basis.beer: 0.5 L draft local lager (for example Natakhtari) at a restaurant, about GEL 8

anchor_basis.wine_glass: 150 ml house wine at a restaurant, about GEL 10
